_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE self-pacing. The cloud routine ticks hourly and I cannot change that, but I decide which ticks deserve a FULL cycle (scan + research + bet) and which are LIGHT (settle + monitor open positions, then stop). Set next_full_cycle_after when a full cycle would be wasted — e.g. no candidate resolves for hours, or research sources are unavailable. A tick always settles and monitors regardless; skipping those is not allowed. LIGHT ticks skip only scan+research: if resolve.py settles ANYTHING on a light tick, that same tick writes the retro and applies any pre-registered grading — settlement grading is never deferred to a later tick (DEEP-2026-08-05: b21e42c123a1 settled on the 06:24Z light tick, its retro was 'deferred to next full cycle', and the 08:15Z full cycle then saw '0 settled this cycle' and wrote nothing — the $5 loss went ungraded for 23h).
reason: 2026-08-05 21:16Z full cycle: priority per CYCLE.md mandate -- integrated the only unintegrated operator-notes.md section (2026-08-05 ~20:30Z, market-selection mandate) into playbook.md: fit rubric (5 scoreable properties), strategy/funnel.jsonl instrumentation schema, exploration-budget rule. First funnel.jsonl entry written this cycle (17 researched candidates logged with fit_score + skip_reason). scan: 4 queries -> 483 candidates, no fallback. Scheduled-release triage: July unemployment brackets (Aug 7 08:30Z) -- fresh consensus (continuumeconomics: rise to 4.3% from 4.2%) matches PM's bracket peak, re-confirms prior cycles; caught and discarded a wrong-year (2025) contamination in one search result (see playbook trap). CPI cluster (Aug 12) and China CPI/UK GDP not re-researched, no new info, thin liquidity. Exploration-budget candidate (operator's own named hypothesis): Hong Kong Aug-6 temperature brackets -- HKO forecast (31C) vs AccuWeather (34C) diverge 3C, more than the 1C bracket width, station identity unconfirmed -- contradictory-source skip, playbook gained a weather-specific trap note and corrected discovery.py's tag-1474 comment (general queries surface ~79 weather markets independent of that tag). MLB book-devig: checked 6 O/U totals and 1 run line with clean single-book odds -- max edge 0.050 (Athletics/Reds), all under min_edge_book_devig 0.07; 4 more O/U markets had line-mismatched or missing book numbers, skipped as benchmark-unreachable. WNBA: 4 moneylines devigged, max edge 0.027, all under threshold. Soccer: Boca Juniors vs Estudiantes 1X2 -- 'best odds' search result mixed different bookmakers per side (composite, not one book's line), a cross-book-mixing variant now formally in the playbook; marginal ~0.06 edge not trusted as computed and below threshold regardless. No bets placed. open-position monitor below. 6 full cycles ran in the last 24h (min_full_cycles_per_day=4, exceeded). Set next_full_cycle_after to 00:16Z (3h cap): tonight's MLB/WNBA games (start ~22:40-23:40Z) were already triaged above and settle automatically regardless of tick type; the next unexplored boundary is the 03:00-06:00Z LoL esports slate, past the 3h cap, worth a look then if still open.
notes: Guardrail on my own laziness: even if I keep deferring, run a full cycle if fewer than min_full_cycles_per_day have run in the last 24h (count from journal/cycles.log). Deferring is for saving effort on genuinely empty windows, never for avoiding hard research. Concrete criteria (DEEP-2026-08-04, after 23/23 full cycles including provably redundant re-research at 0115Z/0215Z/0320Z): defer when EVERY current candidate is either (a) researched to a no-edge/no-benchmark conclusion within the last ~2h with no new information since, or (b) gated on a benchmark/status source known unreachable. Set next_full_cycle_after to the next event boundary (kickoff, report time, new candidates entering the window), never more than 3h out, and never past a known event start time. State the reason. Settle + monitor still run every tick, and a settling tick writes its retro immediately (see _comment). Any cycle-count claim in the reason field must be computed from journal/cycles.log (grep, count), not estimated — 2026-08-04/05 reasons asserted '147' and '21' full cycles in 24h, both arithmetically impossible on an hourly tick.
